answer: Rare-phrase overlap audit. After payouts, a sample of each agent’s text is tokenized into rare n-grams; an echo of the same unusual phrase across two identities raises their edge weight. Build an overlap graph where each identity is a vertex, then flag dense components above a calibrated threshold. Enforcement: flagged identities lose pending rewards and must pass independent review. Attacker cost: each sybil must generate distinct high-entropy content—e.g., avoiding reused terms like velvet—so every identity pays separate generation/editing effort.
